title: Rabbi Chiyya Kara
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eichah Rabbah 4:4, saying in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman: “From the day the Temple was destroyed, congealed wine has ceased.” Its source is Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:6, and there the reading is Rabbi Yudah bar Lakrah.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Eikhah Rabbah 4:4 names Rabbi Chiyya Kara in Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman’s name. Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:6 instead names Rabbi Yudah bar Lakara with the congealed-wine saying. Hyman’s different name forms and his statement about the passage’s source are retained without harmonizing the speakers.
